notes: Each finding identity is transcribed from the audited ry-stdout.json and joined to the auditor's per-diagnostic classification in summary.json; the transcription script re-derives this file and asserts 34 TP / 1108 FP / 0 uncertain over 1,142 diagnostics.
Workstreams are assigned deterministically from the rule code and the auditor rationale (see ecosystem/transcribe-posit-corpus.py); true positives are real defects in upstream package source.

The source audit ran ry 0.8.0 with installed R libraries; ecosystem reports are hermetic (RY_NO_INSTALLED_LIBRARIES=1), so the hermetic run is compared against this transcript informationally rather than as a strict CI gate.
